description: Golden chart reads, pilot of 10 (constitution §27). For each entry open <symbol> on <tf> in the app and scroll so the LAST CLOSED candle is at <as_of>; the window is the ~120 candles back to <window_start>. Write what YOU see into `expected`: UP / DOWN / RANGE / CHOP. The reader's own call is deliberately not shown here, so your label is not anchored by it. Score with: python -m engine.chartread --golden verification/golden-chart-reads.json

labels.note: Defined trading range; late buy-side liquidity sweep/rejection is a bearish rotation inside the broader range, not a full DOWN regime.

Screenshot shows broad horizontal auction with repeated rotations around roughly 62k support and 65-66k resistance; screenshot itself was displayed on 1H, so dates are approximate for regime alignment.
Overall higher-low/higher-high progression with a strong expansion to a new swing high; substantial late retracement makes it borderline but does not erase the broader upward structure.
Strong bearish displacement from the late-May high followed by weaker consolidation/retracement and renewed downside pressure; screenshot boundary dates are approximate by a candle or two.
Persistent lower-high/lower-low structure with repeated bearish continuation and major downside displacement.
Gradual but persistent bearish staircase with lower highs/lows and repeated downside BOS; screenshot boundary dates are approximate by a candle or two.
Well-defined horizontal balance with repeated reversals and little net directional progress; range is clearer than random CHOP.
Visible daily structure advances from roughly 0.29 toward 0.53 with higher highs/higher lows before a late pullback; screenshot boundary dates are approximate.
Bullish structural progression from the Apr 12 low with higher highs and higher lows despite intermediate consolidation; screenshot boundary is approximate.
Dominant visible move is a sustained bullish BOS/HL/HH progression into the May 9-10 high; later pullback/reversal makes the ending mixed but the full screenshot window remains upward overall.
